name: AGT Food and Ingredients Inc.
summary: AGT Food and Ingredients Inc. processes and supplies plant-based ingredients, pulses, grains and staple foods for retail and food industry customers. Its ingredients include flours, proteins, fibres and starches, and it makes extruded goods such as texturized plant protein and gluten-free pasta. It also sells cleaned and packaged pulses, grains, cereals, canned pulses and rice.
